entries.note: Bets, almost always sport or casino betting. Listed separately in case the plural is not reached from the base.
The bets. Listed separately as the definite plural.
He bets or 'bet now' in ads. Casual use ('pariaza pe mine') exists but is rarer.
Bet (past). Mostly 'am pariat pe', ticket talk.
Bettor. Almost only about betting.
Standard Romanian spelling for casino. Figurative use is rare.
Casinos, listed separately as the plural.

The English spelling, used in Romanian ads and handles. Also the Casino de Monte Carlo style place name, rare.
Slang for slot machines, very Romanian. Also used as a joke for any noisy machine, rare.
Card casino game. Almost no ordinary use.
Baccarat, Romanian spelling. The crystal brand writes it the same way, rare.
Lottery (Loto 6/49, Loto 5/40). Also loto as a board game at family evenings.
Betting company. Almost no ordinary use.

Sports betting. The most common ad phrase.
Online betting.
